text: - **CI Python scripts:** unit-tested with `python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/scripts` as the fast `ci-scripts` leg — 104 tests in eight test files (§4; 100 in seven until test_capability_statement.py added its 4; 94 until 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test, whose test_cold_agent.py went 27 → 33 as `ColdAgentStubTest` retired with the stub; 79 in six until 2026-10-14-quality-gates, which added test_coverage_floor.py's 7, 5 leg cases and 3 install cases; 78 until 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship, whose upstream merge added one to test_wpt_area_changes.py), among them the eight contract tests (five until 2026-10-14-quality-gates) of the CI install script `.github/scripts/apt-install.sh` (`InstallScriptTest`), the seven of `CoverageFloorTest`, which pin the coverage floor script `.github/scripts/coverage_floor.py` (.github/scripts/test_coverage_floor.py:17-88), the one test of `BlitzTestsTargetsTest`, which pins the blitz-tests manifest to one test target per file with upstream's `all` target unbuilt (.github/scripts/test_blitz_tests_targets.py:17-26), the four of `CapabilityStatementTest`, which pin `docs/capabilities.md`'s verb and cause names and its five counts, and README.md's count of the MCP tools, to the driver schema's tables — `docs/capabilities.md`, a document with no runtime surface, in test scope through this pin alone (.github/scripts/test_capability_statement.py:75-104), and the workflow invariant that every package install of ci.yml is bounded — the job first ensuring PyYAML by a guarded step, `python3 -c 'import yaml' || bash .github/scripts/apt-install.sh python3-yaml` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:186-199; .github/workflows/ci.yml:191; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:218-235; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:381-495; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:27)
